articles.title: India’s billion-dollar trade juggernaut has an unwanted case of missing balance
articles.summary: India’s early FTAs promised a two-way trade highway, but 15 years later the traffic looks decidedly one-sided. Deficits with ASEAN, Japan and South Korea have ballooned as imports raced ahead of exports. Trade experts say the answer is not to shut the road, but to repair it — from tariff imbalances and non-tariff barriers to poor FTA utilisation and costly inputs at home.

articles.title: ETtech Explainer: Who pays MDR on UPI and who does not
articles.summary: Starting on October 15, banks and payment applications will begin earning revenue from select merchant UPI transactions. Transactions under Rs 2000 will remain exempt from new fees, while person-to-person transfers and small vendor payments under Rs 1 lakh are still free. Merchants will incur a charge of up to forty basis points for transactions over Rs 2000.

articles.title: Explainer -- India's UPI MDR shake-up: What changes and why it matters
articles.summary: India will soon introduce a merchant discount rate on UPI payments. This fee applies to transactions exceeding two thousand rupees with merchants. Some small merchants and rural areas will be excluded from this new charge. This move aims to make the UPI system more self-sustainable and expand its reach. Consumers are not expected to directly pay these new transaction fees.
